title: Watto
franchise: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
description: Watto, a Toydarian junk dealer of Mos Espa, was a prominent gambler and businessperson until one fateful Boonta Eve when his slave, Anakin Skywalker, won the race. He lost everything. Forced to sell everything he had left to survive, he even sold the boy's mother, Shmi Skywalker, to a moisture farmer named Lars, who freed and married her.
